Ashley Lahey (born October 26, 1999) is an American tennis player. Lahey has a career-high singles ranking of 317 by the WTA , achieved on 18 September 2023. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 170, achieved on 25 September 2023. [ 1 ] Lahey won her first bigger ITF title at the 2022 Tyler Pro Challenge , in the doubles draw, partnering Maria Kozyreva . She played college tennis at Pepperdine University .
